# dsh-software-tools
Sidebar **🔧 软件工具** manager for DeepSeek Harness Web. Maintain a curated inventory of local software
— WSL CLI tools and Windows apps reachable via interop — and check the ones you want the model to kn
ow about. The checked set is injected into the model's system prompt as a compact section, so every
session knows what software exists on this machine and how to call it. 中文说明见 README.zh.md。
*Illustrative screenshot: workspace names and spend figures are blurred out; UI details may lag the
eenshot: workspace names and spend figures are blurred out; UI details may lag the current version.*
## Problem
A model (e.g. deepseek-v4-flash) has no idea that you have IDM, ComfyUI, Obsidian, aria2… installed,
let alone how to invoke each one. This plugin turns "local software inventory + invocation recipes"
into a **checkable, persisted, auto-injected** system-prompt section: the model reads the `usage` f
ield and runs the ready-made command.
## Features
| | Capability | Detail |
| 🔧 | Sidebar panel | Tools grouped by category; toggling takes effect on the model's very next requ

est — no restart |
| 📥 | Built-in + user catalog merge | Portable built-in catalog (aria2 / proxy /

playwright / uvx / interop / zstd …); user entries in `catalog.json` override built-ins by id |
| ✏️
| Panel editing | Add one entry from the panel footer (**+ Add entry**: name / description / usage
/ category) and delete a user row inline with a confirmation; built-in rows are read-only. Deleting
backs up `catalog.json`, unchecks the id, and reveals the built-in version again when the row overro

de one |
| 🧠 | System-prompt injection | Checked tools become a compact section on every assembly (`

systemPrompt.section`, same seam as persona / plan-mode) |
| 🛠 | Bundled skill | Ships `add-software
-tool`: the model learns to write newly installed software into the user catalog — no rebuild, no re

start; entries are scoped to usage, not tuning |
| 🔒 | Loopback RPC | Panel ↔ host over a loopback-p
inned RPC channel; reads local JSON only |

/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/` and append to `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart `dsh web` and hard-refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R). A **软件工具** row appears in the panel rail (between
Automation tasks and Task Board).
## Configuration
All optional; zero-config by default:
| Field | Default | Meaning |
| `settingsDir` | `$DSH_HOME/software-tools` | State directory holding `selection.json` + `catalog.j
tingsDir` | `$DSH_HOME/software-tools` | State directory holding `selection.json` + `catalog.json` |
## State files
| File | Purpose |

| `<settingsDir>/selection.json` | `{"ids": ["aria2", …]}` — current selection |
| `<settingsDir>/ca
talog.json` | `{"tools": [entry…]}` — user catalog; same id overrides a built-in |
### Entry field limits
This table is the **authoritative** limit list (hard caps are host-enforced, see `src/catalog.ts`);
the bundled skill and `README.zh.md` reference it instead of restating numbers.
| Field | Hard cap (host rejects beyond it) | Style target |
| `id` | `[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*`, ≤64 chars, unique | derived from the name; only needed for override

s / explicit-API use |
| `name` | ≤200 chars | display name + purpose, e.g. `ffmpeg (audio/video)` |
| `category` | one of `download` / `proxy` / `media` / `browser` / `knowledge` / `runtime` / `model

` / `misc` | `misc` when unsure |
| `desc` | ≤1000 chars (panel only, never injected) | one line, ~4

0–60 chars: "what it is / when to use it" |
| `usage` | ≤2000 chars (injected on **every** request)
| ≤5 executable lines, ~600 chars: command + prerequisites |
Every write to `catalog.json` / `selection.json` is first copied to `<file>.bak.<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>` (
the newest 20 backups per file are kept) and then written atomically (temp file + rename), so a cras
h mid-write cannot truncate the catalog. A user catalog that cannot be **fully** understood is never
rewritten: invalid JSON is reported as `catalogError`, while individual rows that fail validation (
missing `id`/`name`/`desc`/`usage`/`category`) are kept untouched in the file and reported as `catal
ogWarnings`; the panel shows either warning and disables add/remove until the file is fixed. Duplica
te ids are de-duplicated (last row wins) and reported as a warning too.
> **An entry is usage instructions only**: written for the session that is about to call the tool —
what it is, when to use it, the first command to run. Tuning/ops/troubleshooting/history (VRAM gates
, quantisation and KV flags, measured throughput, port-change steps, migration history…) does not be
long here; it belongs in the tool's own docs (README / deploy report / cheat sheet), with at most a
`details in <path>` pointer. The entry is injected on every request, so length is cost — and tuning
needs far more context than a few lines.
### Guardrails (public repository)
Local state belongs in `$DSH_HOME/software-tools/` **only** — never in this checkout:

## How it works
- **Host half** (`src/index.ts`): registers `systemPrompt.section` (`software-tools`, order 200) ren
dered from the current selection, plus the loopback RPC channel `/_dsh-software-tools` (`list` / `se
t` / `add` / `remove`); `list` tags every row with `origin` (`builtin`/`user`/`override`) and `reado

nly`.
- **Browser half** (`src/client/`): contributes two official seats — `sidebar.panellist` (list
: the rail row, whose `id` is the panel key and whose `label` is a thunk so the title follows the ac
tive locale) and `main` (keyed: the panel body the layout renders in the centre). Both wait on `ctx.
slots.inject(key, ...)` for ui-layout / ui-sidebar to declare the seat. Built by `tsdown` into a laz

y-CJS `__ModuleLoader__` bundle (React comes from the host shell).
- **Skill** (`skills/add-software
-tool/`): mounted via `dsh-skill-filesystem`'s `customSkillDirs`, scoped to the plugin's own directo
ry so user skill roots stay untouched.
